acceptanceCriteria: A package whose open rows all have reviewed, receipt-backed witnesses of a non-browser test type at a pinned revision is not returned for missing witnesses.
A returned row names the witness considered and the reason it was insufficient (for example stale review).
A capability query names the environment baseline revision it answered from, and abstains when that baseline is unknown.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1202. (1) Ledger-aware review: the pre-review gate judges only the plan table (browser tests) and ignores row-ledger witnesses of other test types; merge reviewed, receipt-backed witnesses at a pinned revision of every test type into its judgement, flagging only stale reviews. (2) Explicit returns: a returned row names the witness considered and why it was insufficient. (3) Baseline-pinned capability checks: answer 'is there a test observer/control for X' against the revision the test environment runs, not the newest or an arbitrary checkout. Builds on the obligations witness and review-packet work in PR #1189 (V1-1885/1886) and boundary/worklist in PR #1203 (V1-1913/1915); related: V1-1945 (read test repo at reviewed commit), V1-1940 (#1199 env contract / stand-in control routes).
title: GH #1202: ledger-aware pre-review gate (witnesses of any test type), explicit returns, baseline-pinned capability checks
